about: The variants of the FFX voice recordings (Tidus, Yuna, Auron), read by tools/audio/voice-variant.mjs. The default is the Fish Audio Drama 3 clone Bailey picked on 2026-10-18 ("i'll go with the fish clone for all characters"); the two ElevenLabs variants stay for comparison. Folders live outside the repo; a variant is staged as hard links so voice-ship.mjs sees <id>.mp3.

fish-drama3-clone.label: Fish Audio Drama 3, cloned from the cast
fish-drama3-clone.about: The 222 recordings of Tidus, Yuna and Auron rendered with Fish Audio Drama 3 from reference clips of the cast (2 takes each, the take with the lowest word error picked by speech-to-text, a pronunciation lexicon on the text sent to Fish, any inner pause over 370 ms shortened to 340 ms or less). 200 are the FFX chapters of 39.5; 22 are Chapter XXVII (mirror-aeons). Passes the ship gate on its own. Provenance (lexicon, picks, scores) is in the folder beside the takes.

tight.label: pauses shortened
tight.about: The 203 recordings with the 81 over-long inner pauses shortened (<id>.tight.mp3 in the listening folder); the other 122 are the originals. The only variant that passes the ship gate by itself.

recorded.label: as recorded
recorded.about: The 203 recordings exactly as returned. 81 of them hold a pause over 400 ms, which the ship gate fails; this variant installs them with those findings accepted (the ids are listed under accepted in the ship report).
